test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If 2 October 2012 was Tuesday, then what was the day of the week on 1 October 2016?
solution:
Given: **2 October 2012** was Tuesday.

Now,

2012 to 2016 = 4 Years (3 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 4 Years = 1 Leap year and 3 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 3 Ordinary Years have 3 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 3&
